svg.title: Current inputs and planned COS camera and LiDAR integration
svg.desc: LiDAR decoding and existing COS camera and pose inputs are available. Synchronization, calibration, moving-robot correction, fused object tracks, and the robot planner adapter still need implementation and validation.

g.text: Solid boxes: existing inputs or bench tools. Dashed boxes: work still required in this repository.
Clock alignment + measured transforms + motion correction
Camera detections associated with foreground LiDAR clusters
Timestamped object tracks and robot adapter
Image reference, class, range, position, footprint, confidence, age
Unknown or stale data must remain unavailable. Missing points do not prove a clear path.
Validate replay and simulation before steering. Existing BLine autos need an explicit planner integration.
This diagram describes the development plan; it does not claim a completed fused detector or controller.
